description.text:
CohereLabs/tiny-aya-earth fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 16, all linear layers), merged into the base weights on israel/AfriGuard-inst: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is <safety>…</safety> <category>…</category> <response>…</response>.

Its plain counterpart (same base and config) is adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-tiny-aya-earth-lora-merged.

Training config: examples/train_lora/afriguard_inst_tiny-aya-earth_lora_sft.yaml in the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, the tiny-aya-global setup (afriguard_tinyaya_lora_sft.yaml) with only the base model and output paths changed; 1 epoch, 1 GPU, cohere chat template, loss on the response only.

quotes: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt
<safety>safe|unsafe</safety> <category>top_category (always, for safe and unsafe prompts)</category> <response>final reply</response>

serving.notes: config.json is Cohere2ForCausalLM with max_position_embeddings 8192 and no vision_config. No adapter_config.json and no trainer_state.json. generation_config.json sets bos, eos, and pad ids only. Modelfile sets PARAMETER stop <|END_OF_TURN_TOKEN|> and PARAMETER num_ctx 4096, with an optional system slot and no system text. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key. The card prose says 1 GPU; the hyperparameter block says distributed_type: multi-GPU.
